thread:
jin: Quick heads-up — saw microburst outliers on new-13B bring-up. GPTQ build shows ~0.9% absolute drop vs FP16 on our open-qa suite. Sharing traces and a few quick notes.

maria: Can you paste the layerwise diffs and the per-channel kurtosis? Curious if it's concentrated or distributed.

jin: gist: `gcs://redwood-evals/2050012345/new-13b/gptq/trace.json`
Top diffs: layer 16 attention.k channel 42 spike, layer 22 ffn activations heavy tail.
Command I ran:
```
python tools/scan_outliers.py \
  --model new-13B-gptq \
  --quant gptq \
  --dataset open-qa \
  --out artifacts/2050012345
```

alex: From the traces, attention.k ch42 has kurtosis ~24 and max/mean ratio 130x. Looks like microburst rather than persistent offset. Could try per-channel rescale for ch42 or clamp on forward pass.

sasha: Two quick mitigations to try in parallel: 1) surgical per-channel scale: multiply ch42 by 0.6 before quant; 2) skip-quant for FFN layer 22 (keep FP16 rollout for that layer). Both are low-risk.

quant-bot: Bakeoff started — runs: [GPTQ baseline, AWQ per-channel, INT8 symmetric, FP8 dynamic]. Results will land in `gcs://redwood-evals/2050012345/bakeoff/`

maria: If AWQ per-channel reduces spike error but hurts latency, we should evaluate cost/latency profile. Add per-route latency counters.

jin: Quick eval snapshot (open-qa dev set):
- FP16 baseline: acc 89.3%
- GPTQ (no mitigations): acc 88.4% (-0.9)
- AWQ per-channel clamp: acc 88.9% (-0.4)
- INT8 symmetric + clamp: acc 88.6% (-0.7)
- FP8 dynamic (experimental kernels): acc 89.1% (-0.2)

alex: FP8 looks promising on accuracy but need perf and kernel stability on our runtime.

sasha: For rollout plan: try AWQ per-channel + surgical clamp on ch42 in staging, gate 10% traffic with FP16 fallback. If perf is within 5% we can expand.

ops-deploy: I can spin up a staging canary pool and route 5-10% for tests. Need config snippet.

maria: Config snippet (staging rollout):
```
route:
  model: new-13B
  quant_profile: awq_per_channel_clamp
  fallbacks:
    - fp16
  canary: 0.1
  filters:
    - open-qa
```

jin: Running per-layer ablation next to confirm it's mainly layer16/22. Will post updated traces. Thanks all :thumbsup:

sasha: Also add QA eval on long context prompts (2k tokens) — microbursts sometimes show up only at longer seq lengths.

quant-bot: Upload complete: `gcs://redwood-evals/2050012345/bakeoff/results.csv`
